(ङ) डीङ् r. 1st and 4th cls. (डयते डीयते)
1 To fly, to pass through the air.
2 To go, to move.
With अव prefixed,
To fly down, to alight.
With उत्,
To fly up, to soar.
With परि,
To fly round.
With प्र,
To fly well or swiftly.
With सम्,
To fly well or in flocks.
With सम् and उत्,
To fly up by degrees.
